basic_details.job_title: RNU Akashvani Dehradun Casual News Reader Cum Translator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Regional News Unit Akashvani (RNU Akashvani Dehradun) has notified vacancies for Casual News Reader Cum Translator (Hindi)- CNRT and Casual News Reader cum Translator (Kumauni) posts on a contract basis under advertisement number DDN(RNU)/CNRT/2026-27. Candidates can submit their offline application by post or by hand to The Head of Office, Akashvani, Dehradun, P.O. Ajabpur Kalan on or before 31 October 2026. content_sections.heading: RNU Akashvani Dehradun Casual News Reader Cum Translator Job Description
content_sections.text: Casual News Reader Cum Translator (Hindi)- CNRT: To translate, edit and format news stories; Reading news stories in an impactful and interesting way for the audio medium. Casual News Reader cum Translator (Kumauni): To translate, edit and format news stories; Reading news stories in an impactful and interesting way for the audio medium.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of age (Class 10th mark list / 10th certificate issued by State Board / CBSE / ICSE / copy of birth certificate). Proof of essential and desirable qualifications mentioned against the category applied for (academic qualification, professional qualification and work experience). Proof of residence (Aadhaar card / Passport / Driving Licence / Voter ID / Rental Lease Agreement carrying name / residence certificate issued by Tehsildar). Community Certificate (applicable for SC/ST/OBC category) for claiming concession in application fee. One passport-size photograph to be pasted in the designated space in the application form. Transaction ID and proof of application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure comprises three stages: written test, voice test and an interview to assess the professional competence and knowledge of the candidate in the concerned language. Each test carries 100 marks. The syllabus for the written test includes translation from English to Hindi for Hindi News Reader, Hindi to Kumauni for Kumauni News Reader and vice versa, short notes on current affairs and general knowledge, etc. Candidates securing 50 marks and above in the written test will be called for voice test. In the voice test, the following are to be adjudged: voice quality, modulation, diction, pronunciation, and accent. The voice test may be followed by an interview to assess the suitability of the candidate for the RNU job.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application processing fee is non-refundable and must be deposited through the bank account mentioned in the notification (Account Name: Prasar Bharati, BCI, Doordarshan Kendra, Dehradun; Account Number: 31152871600; IFSC Code: SBIN0000630; Branch: SBI DEHRADUN).

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Working on a casual assignment basis for Akashvani will not confer any right for regularisation of services in this organization. Candidates applying for more than one post are required to submit separate applications along with separate processing fees. Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be considered. No TA/DA will be admissible to candidates attending the written test, voice test, interview, etc. The list of eligible candidates shortlisted after scrutiny, along with the date, time, and venue of the written examination, will be displayed on the office notice board and communicated via email or telephone.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application form for RNU Akashvani Dehradun recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by post or by hand is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for Casual News Reader Cum Translator posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 50 years as on the last date for application.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for Hindi News Reader Cum Translator?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate from a recognised university, have proficiency in Hindi language, and have a voice of good quality suited to broadcasting.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application processing fee for General category candidates is ₹300.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SC/ST/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application processing fee for SC/ST/OBC candidates is ₹225.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format by post or by hand to The Head of Office, Akashvani, Dehradun, P.O. Ajabpur Kalan – 248001.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection procedure comprises three stages: a written test carrying 100 marks, a voice test, and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, working on a casual assignment basis for Akashvani will not confer any right for regularisation of services in this organization, and bookings will not normally exceed six days in a month and 72 assignments in a year.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates applying for more than one post are required to submit separate applications along with separate processing fees.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose proof of age, proof of essential and desirable qualifications, proof of residence, community certificate if applicable, one passport-size photograph, and transaction ID and proof of application fee.
